title: Elite: Judgment Across Three Platforms
description: Elite remix of Judgment Across Three Platforms: the same story pressure becomes a sharper tactical problem, not a stat-inflated repeat. Appearance rule: Solar Dominion of Khepra is the source culture humans later copied as Egyptian solar myth; mission terrain and cosmetics must show Aten hand-rays, Ma’at scale geometry, electrum, royal linen-light, faience turquoise, lapis, obsidian, Nile-black silt glass, Red Land jasper.
lore: This mission treats Solar Dominion of Khepra as the origin behind Egyptian solar myth: battlefield architecture, reward cosmetics, relic props, and hazard silhouettes must use Aten hand-rays, Ma’at scale geometry, electrum, royal linen-light, faience turquoise, lapis, obsidian, Nile-black silt glass, Red Land jasper instead of generic historical or RPG dressing.
terrain: tiered sun platforms with simultaneous anchor points and overcharge hazards; source-culture appearance layer: sun-scale courts, pylon shadow lanes, river-light channels, Khepri dawn engines, Ma’at seal platforms, desert storm edges; cosmetic/relic silhouettes: Ma’at was-sceptre blades, electrum wesekh source-plates, Khepri scarab cores, Uraeus counter-edict silhouettes

objectives.primary: Complete Elite: Judgment Across Three Platforms with one active deity while reading tiered sun platforms with simultaneous anchor points and overcharge hazards and preserving faction doctrine.
optional: Stop every reinforcement trigger or defeat the reinforcement commander first
Trigger at least one Momentum or Divinity decision before victory

enemyWaves.entry: split flanks with one enemy already contesting an objective

boss.mechanic: changes start positions, suppresses one recovery lane, and forces objective timing

specialRules: Solar Law: Momentum grows when the lone deity holds marked light lanes without retreating.
Overcharge Law: standing on empowered tiles grants attack reach but increases incoming pressure.
Split Threat: two objectives resolve on opposite sides of the field.
Elite Remix: enemy AI prioritizes objectives and exposed support Titan.
Restricted Recovery: healing or recovery tiles deactivate after use.
Solo Deityic Scale: one active deity occupies the tactical focus; enemies, elites, and bosses scale around that single presence.
victoryConditions: Complete Elite: Judgment Across Three Platforms with one active deity while reading tiered sun platforms with simultaneous anchor points and overcharge hazards and preserving faction doctrine.

firstClear: Elite Aten Ra mission 15 codex shard

stars.three: Primary, secondary, and all optional objectives completed
